owners.name: Sir Jim Ratcliffe & INEOS
owners.description: Demanding billionaire industrialist. Ruthless on modern sports science, data optimization, and cutting deadwood. Will not tolerate bloated wages or aging stars.

owners.name: Todd Boehly & Clearlake Capital
owners.description: Hyper-active private equity consortium. Loves trading, hoarding youth wonderkids, and disruptive deals. Quick to fire executives if European football is missed.

owners.name: Daniel Levy & ENIC
owners.description: Master of fiscal discipline and tough negotiations. Demands you stay strictly within wage budgets and maximize stadium revenue. Rare to sanction big splash signings.

owners.name: Sheikh Mansour & City Football Group
owners.description: Limitless wealth and sovereign backing. Gives total operational freedom to the football department, but expects absolute elite trophies every single season.

owners.name: John W. Henry & FSG
owners.description: Pioneers of data-driven Moneyball. They demand self-sustaining squad management, intelligent contract extensions, and zero reckless deficit spending.

owners.name: Stan Kroenke & KSE
owners.description: Patient and strategic. Willing to invest heavily once a unified philosophy is established. Values harmony between Director and Head Coach.

owners.name: Nassef Sawiris & Wes Edens
owners.description: Ambitious billionaires who fully empowered Unai Emery. If your director decisions cause friction with the manager, they will back the manager over you.

owners.name: Public Investment Fund (PIF)
owners.description: Incredible wealth tempered by strict Premier League Profit and Sustainability regulations. Expects smart growth without breaking compliance rules.

owners.name: Tony Bloom
owners.description: Algorithmic genius and professional bettor. Hands-off on daily micromanagement, but insists on scouting hidden gems in South America and mainland Europe.

owners.name: Matthew Benham
owners.description: Statistical analytics purist. Values long-term model fidelity over short-term panic buys. Never gets swayed by media sensationalism.

owners.name: David Sullivan
owners.description: Notorious hands-on chairman. Frequently negotiates deals personally and has strong preferences for domestic British stars. Clashes frequently with directors.

owners.name: Evangelos Marinakis
owners.description: Extremely volatile and passionate. Has been known to sack managers and directors on a 3-game losing streak. Highly stressful boardroom environment.

owners.name: The Friedkin Group
owners.description: New American stewards looking to restore stability after years of reckless spending and point deductions. Prioritizes financial sanity and defensive steel.

owners.name: Aiyawatt Srivaddhanaprabha (King Power)
owners.description: Devoted, loyal family ownership. High emotional patience, treats the club with deep warmth, but expects you to respect the club culture and fans.

owners.name: Shahid Khan
owners.description: Billionaire sports magnate. Gives decent transfer war chests and enjoys exciting marquee flair, provided the team stays away from the drop zone.

owners.name: Bill Foley (Black Knight Football)
owners.description: Aggressive multi-club investor from Las Vegas. Backs ambitious signings and wants attacking, entertaining football on the south coast.

owners.name: Guo Guangchang & Fosun International
owners.description: Conglomerate backing that has shifted from big spending to self-sufficiency and profitable trading. Demands net-positive transfer windows.

owners.name: Steve Parish & Multi-Shareholders
owners.description: Complex multi-stakeholder boardroom (Parish, Textor, Blitzer, Harris). Can lead to boardroom paralysis, but excels at developing young talent.

owners.name: Gamechanger 20 & ORG Portfolio
owners.description: Thrilled with back-to-back promotions. Extremely supportive of the management setup and willing to back youth with low expectations of miracles.

owners.name: Sport Republic (Dragan Solak)
owners.description: Data-driven investment consortium. Heavily favors acquiring emerging European prospects and adhering to strict analytical performance models.

owners.name: 49ers Enterprises
owners.description: NFL-backed powerhouse ownership. Highly ambitious with deep corporate standards. Will not tolerate staying in the Championship for multiple seasons.

owners.name: ALK Capital (Alan Pace)
owners.description: Analytical sports tech investors. Heavily reliant on debt leverage, so promotion is essential to service the club’s financing obligations.

owners.name: Kyril Louis-Dreyfus
owners.description: Youngest owner in English football. Highly progressive, committed to fielding an ultra-young, exciting squad and avoiding mercenary veterans.

owners.name: Gino Pozzo
owners.description: The most ruthless trigger finger in world football. Has sacked dozens of coaches. If the club falls 3 points outside the playoffs, heads will roll.

owners.name: Dejphon Chansiri
owners.description: Controversial, volatile micromanager who publicly feuds with managers and supporters. Constant fan protests make this a high-stress post.

owners.name: Tom Brady & Knighthead Capital
owners.description: Super Bowl champion Tom Brady and billionaire hedge fund Knighthead. Spending unprecedented millions for League One. Anything less than 1st place is failure.

owners.name: Ryan Reynolds & Rob McElhenney
owners.description: Hollywood owners who adore the club and town. Tremendous fan goodwill, hands-off in sporting interference, but passionate about fairy-tale success.

owners.description: Limitless state-backed wealth with a long horizon. Funds world-class signings and rarely interferes day to day.

owners.name: Silicon Valley Apex Ventures
owners.description: Algorithm-obsessed investors who want every signing justified by the numbers and results fast.

owners.name: Atlantic Private Capital Group
owners.description: Return-hungry equity firm. Wants trophies and commercial growth now, and will change course quickly.

owners.name: The Heritage Supporters Trust
owners.description: Fan-owned trust that values the academy, community and long-term stability over spending sprees.

owners.name: Azure Sands Sovereign Fund
owners.description: Ambitious state fund building a global football brand. Backs big names and trusts the executive team.

owners.name: Nordic Horizon Wealth Fund
owners.description: Disciplined northern fund with a sustainable ethos. Invests steadily in youth and infrastructure.

owners.name: Pacific Meridian Holdings
owners.description: Calculating investors who like efficient deals and expanding the club's reach across Asia.

owners.name: Caspian Crown Investment Authority
owners.description: Lavish but demanding. Pours in money and expects visible success almost immediately.

owners.name: Quantum Pitch Ventures
owners.description: Start-up mindset applied to football. Treats every transfer as a data-driven investment.

owners.name: Helix Data Sports Group
owners.description: Smaller analytics-first group that works closely with the sporting director on recruitment models.

owners.name: Berlin Algorithm Capital
owners.description: Pressing-obsessed owners who back young players and swing hard when the plan stalls.

owners.name: Zenith Cloud Holdings
owners.description: Tech giant chasing global fans. Lets the executives work but wants star power and highlights.

owners.name: Ironbridge Sports Partners
owners.description: Hard-nosed operators who track every pound and expect results within a season.

owners.name: Redwood Stadium Equity
owners.description: Stadium-focused investors who want committed, hard-working players the fans can relate to.

owners.name: Summit Ridge Capital
owners.description: Flashy investors who chase attention and big announcements, but turn on results quickly.

owners.name: Bluegrass Franchise Group
owners.description: Franchise-style owners focused on margins. Expect profit on every deal and tight budgets.

owners.name: The Terrace Fans' Collective
owners.description: Lifelong supporters who prize honest effort and local identity over glamour.

owners.name: Red Rose Community Trust
owners.description: Community trust with modest funds. Wants the academy to feed the first team.

owners.name: Celtic Fringe Supporters Alliance
owners.description: Passionate supporters alliance. Slow to panic and loyal to whoever shares their values.

owners.name: Fortress Street Fan Ownership Group
owners.description: Crowdfunded group with surprising reach. Trusts the executives and backs a long project.
